# #2649: Patch: Your Table adds 30 stats for Temporary, Brittle, Tradable, Freeze, Created cards and more
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

"Your table" (R639, R1582000, R1584000, R1743000; `apps/web/src/stats/`) shows 35 stats. None of them is about the game's own mechanics: Temporary, Brittle, Tradable, Reborn, Divine Shield, Armor, Windfury, Lifesteal, Flashback, Freeze, Starships, Created cards. This patch adds **30 stats**, almost all of them about one mechanic each, so the floor keeps feeling bottomless (R1743000) and gets to show what makes JackiOh JackiOh. Every stat ships. If one truly cannot be read from what the views show, the ruling note says so with the reason; it is not quietly dropped.

Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no engine, event or endpoint change.
- **R97 holds.** A counter only ever names a card the view shows, from the viewer's seat, through `readable` / `defIdOn`. Where a stat needs to know what a card was before the batch (its keywords, whether it was in the hand, whether it was Frozen), it reads the view before the batch, as R1743000's overkill does. With no view before, it counts nothing.
- **Same rules as the current stats.** A stat's card is never a token, ties go to the lower id, a share needs `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` of its whole and caps its part at the whole, and a stat the device has no data for is left out.
- **Storage.** Each new counter is stored under the same key and version, read as 0 when missing or not a whole positive number, emptied by Clear, and never synced (R1142000). `biggestKill` keeps a maximum, as `biggestHit` does; every other new counter is a sum.
- **A card's keywords** are its keywords in the view. For a hand card that sets none, they are its catalog face's printed keywords (R243: a hand card's `keywords` are set only where they differ from the face).

### New stage animations

Each is an existing board animation (`game/animations.ts`) whose target lands on a card on the field, so the stage plays it on its card the way R1584000 plays the others. There is no new keyframe, effect recipe or cue. Add them to `STAGE_ANIMATIONS` / `stageEvents` in `showcaseStage.ts`.

**A warning before the consequence, the way Allure plays it.** Allure's stat lays its mark on the card, then the steal follows (R1584000). The board warns about Brittle and Temporary in the same way. A card on the field at its last Brittle count wears Allure's aura in gray (`BRITTLE_LAST_COLOR`, #2270), and a hand card at its last Temporary count wears it in fuchsia (`TEMPORARY_LAST_COLOR`, #2437). These two auras come from the card's state, not from a `marked` event (`Card.tsx` passes `bareAura` to `CardMarks`). So a `StageScript` gains an optional `aura: MarkColor`:
- `StatStage` draws `<CardMarks marks={[]} bareAura={aura} … />` on the stage card from its entrance until the first beat starts, held at least `SHOWCASE_BEAT_GAP_MS` on screen.
- The aura is dropped as that beat plays, so the warning reads first, then what it warned of.
- Under reduced motion the still card shows the aura and nothing plays.
- This is the board's own aura in the board's own color, not a new visual. `showcaseStage.test.ts` and `StatShowcase.test.tsx` check that the aura is drawn before the beat and is gone when it plays.

| Stage animation | Warning first | The board event(s) | Board keyframe / effects recipe | Card comes back |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crumble` | Brittle's gray aura | `crumbled` | `jk-dissolve` / death | yes |
| `expire` | Temporary's fuchsia aura | `exiled` (the board's `discarded` targets the hand, which the stage has none of) | `jk-exile-fade` / void | yes |
| `inTime` | Temporary's fuchsia aura | `cardPlayed`, as #2648's `cast` plays it (or #2648's fallback) | `jk-card-played` / cast | n/a |
| `doom` | none: its first beat is the mark | `marked` `"destroy"` (red, Classic #20's "marked for death", R437), `added: true`, then `destroyed`: Allure's own two-beat shape | brand, then `jk-dissolve` / death | yes |
| `stamp` | none | `summoned` three times in a row, like a production line (as `windfury` repeats its lunge) | `jk-summon-scale` ×3 | n/a |
| `exile` | none | `exiled` | `jk-exile-fade` / void | yes |
| `bounce` | none | `bounced` | `jk-bounce-to-hand` / bounce | yes |
| `hit` | none | `damage` aimed at the card | `jk-damage-shake` / impact | n/a |
| `heal` | none | `healed` aimed at the card | `jk-heal-pop` / heal | n/a |
| `armor` | none | `damageAbsorbed` aimed at the card | `jk-armor-absorb` / armor | n/a |
| `reborn` | none | `destroyed`, then `summoned` (two beats, as `allure` has) | `jk-dissolve`, then `jk-summon-scale` | by the second beat |
| `windfury` | none | `attackDeclared` twice | `jk-lunge` ×2 | n/a |
| `freeze` | none: the frost is a mark, as Allure's is | `marked` `"frozen"` (the engine's `FROZEN_MARK`), `added: true` | frost `jk-radiant-pulse` / brand | n/a |
| `thaw` | none | `marked` `"frozen"` added, then `added: false` | the same, twice | n/a |
| `launch` | none | `starshipLaunched` | `jk-radiant-pulse` / brand | n/a |

`showcaseStage.test.ts` checks that each one's entry lands on the stage card. The `lunge` stats below follow the card-type rule of #2648: `cast` on a Spell, `trap` on a Trap.

### The stats

The side is "you" unless the table says otherwise. A line whose number is 1 says it in the singular where it has a word to bend.

**Temporary**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Use It or Lose It** | `tempExpired`: a `discarded` of the viewer's card in a batch holding the viewer's `turnEnded` (cleanup, R637), whose card was Temporary in the viewer's hand in the view before | "slipped away unplayed {n}×" | `expire` |
| **Just in Time** | `tempPlayed`: the viewer's `cardPlayed` of a card that was Temporary in their hand in the view before. The card with the highest `tempPlayed` per (`tempPlayed + tempExpired`) | "played {n} of the {m} times it was Temporary" | `inTime` |

**Brittle**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sand Castle** | `crumbled`: the viewer's card in a `crumbled` | "crumbled {n}×" | `crumble` |
| **Outlasted** | `crumbledAgainst`: the opponent's card in a `crumbled` | "waited it out {n}×" | `crumble`, opponent |
| **Good Feng Shui** | `fengShuiGood`: a `fengShui` with `outcome` positive on the viewer's play, naming the card `instanceId` shows | "blessed by Feng Shui {n}×" | `radiant` |
| **Bad Feng Shui** | `fengShuiBad`: the same, negative (it was given Brittle 2 and the hit follows, R983). Brittle 2 is not the last count, so it does not wear the gray aura | "cursed by Feng Shui {n}×" | `hit` |

**Tradable**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hot Potato** | `traded`: after the viewer's `traded`, the `shuffledIn` whose `instanceId` the view before showed in the viewer's hand (R1838001: `traded` names no card) | "traded away {n}×" | `bounce` |
| **Trade-In Value** | `tradeDrawn`: the viewer's `drawn` after their `traded` in the same batch | "pulled from a trade {n}×" | `entrance` |

**Created cards**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mass Produced** | `created`: each Created instance (R943: the view marks it `created: true`, wherever the viewer may read it) that the view shows on the viewer's side (hand, field, piles, exile, resolving, a face-up backrow card), counted once per instance per game however often it moves or is seen. The log keeps the instance ids it has counted in this game, never stored. A dealt card, the opponent's Created card and a face-down card the viewer cannot read count nothing; a token is counted, as every counter counts tokens, but never shown (R1743000), so the stat names the most-created non-token card. The Coin is a card the catalog holds, so it can win | "created {n}×" | `stamp` |

**Combat and keywords**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Executioner** | `kills`: an opponent's card in a `destroyed` whose `killerId` names the viewer's card (in the view, or in the view before, since the killer may die in the same combat) | "took down {n} enemies" | `lunge` |
| **Giant Slayer** | `biggestKill` (a max): the largest `maxHealth` of such a victim | "felled a {n}-health giant" | `lunge` |
| **Second Wind** | `reborn`: the viewer's `destroyed`, then their `summoned` of the same `defId` in the same batch, for a Unit that had Reborn in the view before | "rose again {n}×" | `reborn` |
| **Bubble Wrap** | `shieldsLost`: a `divineShieldLost` on the viewer's Unit | "shield popped {n}×" | `shield` |
| **Iron Wall** | `armorAbsorbed`: on the viewer's Units, each `damage`'s `absorbed` plus each `damageAbsorbed`'s amount (R1360, R1361) | "shrugged off {n} damage" | `armor` |
| **Punching Bag** | `damageTaken`: the sum of `damage` amounts aimed at the viewer's Unit | "took {n} damage" | `hit` |
| **Double Tap** | `doubleAttacks`: a viewer Unit's second `attackDeclared` in one turn. The log keeps this turn's attackers, cleared on `turnStarted` and never stored | "attacked twice in a turn {n}×" | `windfury` |
| **Vampire** | `lifesteal`: a `healed` that #2648's heal source credits to a `damage` by the viewer's card that had Lifesteal (its keywords, or a Spell's printed ones) | "drained {n} health" | `heal` |
| **Martyr** | `sacrificed`: the viewer's own deaths that #2648 no longer counts as `destroyed` (a Tribute, a Sacrifice, the player's own effect), crumbles excepted | "gave itself up {n}×" | `doom` |

**Freeze and thaw** (the `"frozen"` mark: `marked` `added: true` is a freeze and `added: false` a thaw, `freeze.rs`)

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cold Snap** | `froze`: a freeze landing on an opponent's Unit, credited to the viewer's card that #2648's source rule (the last play, activation, Trap, attack or damage source before it in the batch) names; none, or the opponent's, counts nothing | "froze {n} enemies" | `lunge` (the card is the one that froze, so it acts rather than wearing the frost) |
| **Brain Freeze** | `frozen`: a freeze landing on the viewer's Unit | "frozen {n}×" | `freeze` |
| **Spring Thaw** | `thawed`: a thaw (`added: false`) on the viewer's Unit that is still on the field in the view after the batch (a thaw, not a death) | "thawed out {n}×" | `thaw` |
| **Shatter** | `shattered`: an opponent's Unit in a `destroyed` that was Frozen (`UnitView.frozen`) in the view before, credited as Executioner's kill is, or to the viewer's last actor when there is no killer | "shattered {n} frozen enemies" | `lunge` |

**Everything else**

| Stat | Card: counter, and how it is read | Line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Encore** | `flashback`: the viewer's `cardPlayed` with `from` the graveyard (Flashback, R783012) | "played from the graveyard {n}×" | `reborn` |
| **Bargain Hunter** | `manaSaved`: the sum of the catalog cost less `costPaid` (never below 0) over the viewer's `cardPlayed`, skipping a play with `x`, `embiggened` or `onDraw` | "saved {n} mana" | `radiant` |
| **Denied** | `countered`: the viewer's card in a `countered` with `player` the viewer | "countered {n}×" | `exile` |
| **Nope** | `counterspells`: a `countered` of the opponent's play whose `byInstanceId` names the viewer's card | "stopped {n} plays cold" | `trap` (a Spell plays `cast`) |
| **Burnt Toast** | `burned`: the viewer's card in a `burned` (a full hand, R4) | "burned from a full hand {n}×" | `death` |
| **Frequent Flyer** | `bounced`: the viewer's card in a `bounced` | "bounced back to hand {n}×" | `bounce` |
| **Liftoff** | `launched`: each piece definition in the viewer's `starshipLaunched`'s `pieces` | "flew in {n} launched Starships" | `launch` |
| **Brick** | counters only: the highest `drawn - played`, needing `drawn` of at least `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` | "drawn {n}×, played {m}×" | `exile` |

That makes 65 stats in all. Add each key to `SHOWCASE_KEYS`; the bag (R1743000) needs no change.

### Acceptance

- A ruling note in this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3; its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`) amends R1743000 and R1584000 (the stage's aura lead-in). It records each reading choice above and the alternative rejected; for Mass Produced, crediting the seat the card ended up with rather than R2089000's `creator`, which no view forwards. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- `model.test.ts` / `store.test.ts` / `sync.test.ts`: each new counter sums (`biggestKill` keeps its max), reads as 0 from an older or bad stored value, is emptied by Clear and is not sent.
- `track.test.ts`, one test per counter: it counts from its events from the viewer's seat, never names a hidden card, counts nothing for the opponent's mirror case, and counts nothing with no view before where it needs one. Also:
  - Use It or Lose It counts nothing for a non-Temporary discard;
  - Double Tap counts nothing for one attack a turn;
  - Spring Thaw counts nothing for a frozen Unit that died;
  - Shatter counts nothing for a Unit that was not Frozen;
  - Mass Produced counts a Created instance once however many views show it or zones it passes through, counts two instances of one card as 2, and counts nothing for a dealt card or the opponent's Created card.
- `showcase.test.ts`: each of the 30 stats is tested for its card, a lower-id tie, its line (the singular too), the `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` floor where it applies, its absence with no data, and a token passed over (Mass Produced's most-created token gives way to the next card).
- `showcaseStage.test.ts`: each new stage animation plays the board's entry for its event(s) on the stage card, and the ones that bring the card back do. `crumble` carries `BRITTLE_LAST_COLOR` and `expire` / `inTime` carry `TEMPORARY_LAST_COLOR`; `doom`'s first beat is the red `destroy` mark; `stamp` is three `summoned` beats.
- `StatShowcase.test.tsx`: the aura is drawn on the stage card before the first beat and gone once it plays, and under reduced motion the still card wears it.
- `zh-CN.json` has every new title and line with the same tokens (`i18n.test.ts`).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2648, whose death rule (Martyr, Shatter), heal source (Vampire, Cold Snap) and `cast` animation this builds on, and which edits the same files (`showcase.ts`, `track.ts`, `showcaseStage.ts`). Amends R1743000 (#1743) and R1584000.

**Steps**

   - `export const DESTROY_MARK = "destroy";` and `export const DESTROY_MARK_COLOR: MarkColor = "red";` (Classic #20's mark, R437).

2. `stats/model.ts`.
   - Append to `CARD_COUNTERS`, in this order: `tempExpired, tempPlayed, crumbled, crumbledAgainst, fengShuiGood, fengShuiBad, traded, tradeDrawn, created, kills, biggestKill, reborn, shieldsLost, armorAbsorbed, damageTaken, doubleAttacks, lifesteal, sacrificed, froze, frozen, thawed, shattered, flashback, manaSaved, countered, counterspells, burned, bounced, launched`.

   - Each new counter gets `0` in `NO_COUNTS`, a `Readonly<Record<string, number>>` field of `GameLog` with a one-line `/** R2649000: … */`, and `Object.freeze({})` in `EMPTY_LOG`.

     - `createdIds: readonly string[]`: the Created instances counted this game.
     - `attackers: Readonly<Record<string, number>>`: this turn's attacks, by instance id.
     - Both are documented as "never stored". In `EMPTY_LOG` they are `Object.freeze([]) as readonly string[]` and `Object.freeze({})`.
   - `addGame` and `logIsEmpty` need no change.

3. `stats/track.ts`.
   - **Imports:** `CATALOG` from `@jackioh/cards`; `hasKeyword`, `type Keyword`, `type UnitView` from `@jackioh/shared`; `printedCost` from `../game/decks.ts`; `FROZEN_MARK`. Append "R2649000: …" to the header.
   - **Helpers:**
     - `ownDefId(view, before, id)` = `defIdOn(before === null ? [view.you] : [view.you, before.you], id)`.
     - `cardOn(side, id): CardView | undefined` uses `cardsOnSide(side).find`. `unitOn(side, id): UnitView | undefined` searches `side.units` and `side.carried ?? []`. Both return `undefined` for null or `HIDDEN_ID`.
     - `keywordsOf(card: CardView): readonly Keyword[]` = `card.keywords ?? CATALOG[card.defId]?.[card.radiant ? "radiant" : "base"].keywords ?? []` (R243).
     - `sourceAfter(event, view): string | null | undefined`: move `countHealing`'s four source branches into it verbatim, returning `undefined` for any other event. `countHealing` calls it.
   - **`countEvent` adds** (ids via `readable`):
     - `cardPlayed` by the viewer, besides `played`: `from === "graveyard"` → `flashback`. Unless `x !== undefined`, `embiggened === true` or `onDraw === true`, add `Math.max(0, printedCost(def.cost) - costPaid)` to `manaSaved` when it is above 0 and `CATALOG[id]` exists.
     - `crumbled` → `crumbled` if `owner === viewer`, else `crumbledAgainst`.
     - `countered` with `player === viewer` → `countered`. `burned` / `bounced` with `owner === viewer` → `burned` / `bounced`.
     - `starshipLaunched` by the viewer → `launched` once per readable entry of `pieces`.
   - **`countDeaths`:** where a death is not caused, add `else if (event.owner === view.viewer && actor === view.viewer) next = logWith(next, "sacrificed", id)` (Martyr). A death with no actor still counts for nobody.
   - **New exported functions**, each `(log, view, fresh, before)` and walking `fresh` in order:
     - `countCreated(log, view)`: each card of `cardsOnSide(view.you)` with `created === true`, a readable `defId` and an `instanceId` not in `log.createdIds` → `created` +1, and append the id.
     - `countKills`:
       - Keep a `crumbled` set, as `countDeaths` does.
       - `actorCard` is the readable `defId` of the viewer's `cardPlayed` / `activated` / `trapFired`, or `ownDefId` of an `attackDeclared`'s attacker; otherwise null.
       - On a `destroyed` with `owner !== view.viewer` that does not follow its `crumbled`: `killer = ownDefId(view, before, killerId)`. With a killer → `kills` +1 and `logMax(…, "biggestKill", killer, event.maxHealth)`.
       - When `before` shows the unit (`unitOn(before.opponent) ?? unitOn(before.you)`) with `frozen === true`: `shattered` +1 to `killerId === null ? actorCard : killer`, when that is non-null.
     - `countHealing(log, view, fresh, before = null)`:
       - Add a `drain` flag. Set it on a `damage` whose `sourceAfter` is non-null and whose source `cardOn(before.you, sourceId)` has Lifesteal in `keywordsOf`. Any other source change clears it.
       - The first `healed` after it also adds to `lifesteal`, then clears the flag.
       - With no `before`, there is no `lifesteal`.
     - `countTaken`:
       - `divineShieldLost` → `shieldsLost` for `ownDefId(instanceId)`.
       - A `damage` whose `ownDefId(targetId)` is non-null → `damageTaken` += `amount` (when > 0) and `armorAbsorbed` += `absorbed ?? 0` (when > 0).
       - `damageAbsorbed` → `armorAbsorbed` += `absorbed`.
     - `countDoubleAttacks(log, view, fresh)`: `turnStarted` resets `attackers` to `{}`. An `attackDeclared` with `defIdOn([view.you], attackerId)` → `attackers[attackerId]` +1; exactly at 2 → `doubleAttacks` +1.
     - `countFreezes`: track `source` via `sourceAfter`. For a `marked` with `mark === FROZEN_MARK`:
       - added, `seatOf([before, view], instanceId) === opponentOf(view.viewer)` and `source` non-null → `froze[source]`;
       - added and `ownDefId` non-null → `frozen`;
       - not added and `unitOn(view.you, instanceId)` readable → `thawed`.
     - `countTemporary`: counts nothing without `before`.
       - `temp` = ids of `before.you.hand` cards (when the hand is an array) whose `keywordsOf` has Temporary.
       - `ended` turns true at the viewer's `turnEnded` and false at any `turnStarted`.
       - A `discarded` with `owner === viewer`, `ended`, and in `temp` → `tempExpired`. The viewer's `cardPlayed` in `temp` → `tempPlayed`.
     - `countTrades`:
       - `owed` and `trades` count the viewer's `traded`. The viewer's `drawn` while `owed > 0` → `tradeDrawn`, and `owed` −1.
       - With `before` and `trades > 0`: the first `trades` cards of `before.you.hand` with `tradable === true` that neither side of `view` shows (`cardOn`) → `traded`.
     - `countReborn`: counts nothing without `before`. A `destroyed` with `owner === viewer` whose `unitOn(before.you)` has Reborn queues its readable `defId`. The viewer's `summoned` of a queued `defId` takes one off the queue → `reborn`.

       - The viewer's `fengShui` → `ownDefId(instanceId)` → `fengShuiGood` (`positive`) or `fengShuiBad`.

   - Local constants: `STAGE_AMOUNT = 1` (the stage's hit, heal and absorb), `STAMP_BEATS = 3`, `WINDFURY_BEATS = 2`.
   - New `stageEvents` cases (p, q and id as now; every event on `side`):

     | Case | Events |

     | `crumble` | `crumbled {instanceId: id, defId, owner: p, zone: "field"}` |
     | `expire`, `exile` | `exiled {id, defId, owner: p}` |
     | `inTime` | `stageEvents("cast", …)` |
